payload.title: Run Data Assimilation
payload.description: This notebook executes a data assimilation process to reproduce the LMRv2.1 climate reconstruction as described by Tardif et al. 2019. It utilizes the _cfr_ codebase without modifications, running on high-performance computing resources.

steps.description: Set up the environment by loading necessary modules and checking the version of the cfr library.
steps.title: Initialize Environment

steps.description: Load and filter proxy data using the ProxyDatabase class from the cfr library.
steps.title: Load Proxies

steps.description: Load the CMIP5 CCSM4 climate model data as the model prior for the reconstruction.
steps.title: Load Model Prior

steps.description: Load calibration datasets including GISTEMPv4 temperature data and GPCCv6 precipitation data.
steps.title: Load Calibration Data

steps.description: Calibrate Proxy System Models (PSMs) to establish relationships between proxy data and climate variables.
steps.title: Calibrate PSMs

steps.description: Execute the forward model using the calibrated PSMs to generate pseudoproxies.
steps.title: Run PSMs

steps.description: Annualize and regrid the model prior fields to prepare them for data assimilation.
steps.title: Annualize and Regrid Model Prior Fields

dependencies: Annualize and Regrid Model Prior Fields
steps.description: Optionally save the job object for later use or reloading.
steps.title: Save Job Object

dependencies: Annualize and Regrid Model Prior Fields
steps.description: Execute the data assimilation solver using the Kalman Filter to generate climate field reconstructions.
steps.title: Run DA Solver

steps.description: Perform checks on the generated reconstructions by plotting climate fields and ensemble time series.
steps.title: Figure Checks
